summary: Harden polyglot snippet escaping, symlink ancestors, float overflow, surrogates, and bundle IO

delivery.outcome: Eliminate command/quote injection in polyglot URI snippet renderers, extract shared descriptor-safe I/O and strict JSON decoding into operations/urp_io.py (< 500 lines), reject symlinked ancestors, 1e309 float overflow, lone UTF-16 surrogates, and URI dot-segments/quotes/controls, cache compiled JSON Schema validators, and harden operations/bundle.py with atomic writes and regenerated bundle.json.
nonGoals: Add network or execution authority to conformance.py
Modify normative package JSON Schema definitions

architecture.decision: Extract descriptor-safe regular-file/symlink-ancestor I/O and strict finite/surrogate-free JSON decoding into operations/urp_io.py, cache compiled Draft202012Validator instances in operations/conformance.py, escape shell/JS/TS/Rust literals in operations/uri_contract.py, and verify all standard operations files in operations/bundle.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert operations/*.py, bundle.json, and tests/test_hardening.py to acceptedBaseSha.
